summary: Contradiction-check guidance added to the record_decision write path (guidance only, no auto-supersede). (1) lib/mcp-core.js record_decision description now instructs: search_knowledge for related CURRENT notes first; pass `supersedes` on clear contradiction; on uncertain contradiction, do NOT supersede — note the tension in the summary. (2) daemon.js POST /overlay/note: when created WITHOUT supersedes, scans current notes with the existing scoreNodeAgainstTokens/suggestToks scorer at SUGGEST_DUP_THRESHOLD (0.6, same bar as the duplicate-task warning) and returns a non-fatal `hint` naming the near-match + the supersede_note call to retire it. Verified live: daemon restarted (no hot reload), /health ok, hint fires on a true near-duplicate (correct note key) and stays null below threshold; test notes removed from overlay; tests pass.
